frame: levelled world: metres, z up, floor z=0; yaw about +z; size = (along yaw, across, height)
states: state: both = in both videos; A or B = only there (follows a removed / added change); moved = positions per state; merged = folded into the moved object it was the other end of. In shared, frames count A's keyframes then B's; seen_by and the sessions lists use each video's own
